name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated continuation is related to the context and maintains the flow of the conversation. High scores indicate that the continuation is closely connected to the context and contributes to the conversation in a meaningful way.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical consistency and grammatical correctness of the generated continuation. High scores indicate that the continuation is well-structured, grammatically correct, and logically consistent with the context.

name: Informativeness
description: Assesses the amount of new, interesting, and relevant information provided in the generated continuation. High scores indicate that the continuation offers valuable insights, facts, or opinions that contribute to the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Measures the ability of the generated continuation to stimulate further conversation or interest. High scores indicate that the continuation is engaging, thought-provoking, and encourages the conversation to continue.

name: Fluency
description: Evaluates the language quality and naturalness of the generated continuation. High scores indicate that the continuation is fluent, natural-sounding, and free of awkward or unnatural expressions.
